title: A 55% holder has publicly ruled out a sale

input.facts: Clinical analytics subscriptions for hospital groups; recurring revenue is 70% of sales. The share price fell 35% on a one-off contract loss. The founding holding company owns 55% and stated at the annual meeting that it will not sell its stake under any circumstances. No regulatory issue.

why: A controlling shareholder who ruled out a sale is a kill criterion: Reject.
